applies_to: Multiparameter sonde campaigns in the 'coastal' domain profile with role-diverse stations (harbour/embayment + open-coast when relevant).
Decision support for monitoring *design* — not real-time regulatory compliance enforcement.
Multiparameter sonde campaigns with salinity/conductivity and DO/pH coverage.
Screening bands are not regulatory limits and are not site cutoffs.
Campaign designs with comparable station count scale (this campaign n_stations=6).
does_not_apply_to: Universal numeric thresholds transplanted to other sites without re-running CIEML stages.
Sites lacking the domain core variable set required for physical/QA engines.
Causal attribution of pollution sources without independent tracers and Stage 10+ evidence.
Satellite-only or tide-gauge-only networks without in situ sondes.
Unobserved habitats / seasons / forcing regimes (unknown transfer ≠ safe transfer).
payload.transfer_rule: Re-run CIEML Stages 4–9 (features through anomalies) on the new campaign; reuse framework logic and domain profile, not site-specific numeric cutoffs or regime names.
